cohort: Women who underwent robotic gynaecological surgeries between 2015 and 2022 at a single quaternary care centre
finding: Robotic surgery in gynaecology was found to be safe and effective across a range of procedures, offering a promising alternative for comprehensive gynaecological surgical care.
mod_finding: This study mentions robotic surgery use in gynecology, including hysterectomy and myomectomy, but does not focus on mode of delivery.
